title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Isibonelo ngokubona izinkinga ezihlala kwezomthetho
bridge: Ngesi, ukubona izinkinga ezihlala kwezomthetho siyathusa ukusebenzisa isikhathi sokuqala esijwayelekile emva kwamazwi okubona. NgesiNgisi, isijwayelekile asikwazi ukusetshenziswa kangcono; kuthandwa ukusetshenziswa kwesakhiwo esikhombisa noma amakhiwo akhombisa. Ngokwesibonelo, 'angikholelwa ukuthi kuhle' kusho 'I don't think it is right' (hhayi 'it be right'). Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusetshenziswa kwesho 'should' ne 'would' ukukhunjulwa nokubeka izimo azikho isilinganiso esisodwa ngesi, lapho siyathusa ukusetshenzisa isimo esijulile. Khomba indima yezisho nezimo ezingenakho ukuba nesikhathi esishiyane ngesiNgisi.
rule: Ukubona izinkinga ezihlala kwezomthetho ngesiNgisi ehlekelweni B2, usebenzisa: 1) 'Ngiyakholelwa/ ngiyakholwa/ ngiyakholwa' + isakhiwo esikhombisa: 'Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi...' (hhayi isijwayelekile). 2) Amakhiwo: 'should' (ukukhunjulwa), 'ought to' (okomthetho), 'must' (ukubalwa okukhulu), 'can't' (ukungakwazi), 'could' (ukungakwazi), 'would' (ukubeka izimo). 3) Izakhiwo zokubona/ukungaboni: 'Ngiyavuma... ngenxa...', 'Ngibona ukubona kwakho, kodwa...', 'Kungenzeka ukuthi kunjalo, kodwa...'. 4) Izimo zokubeka izimo ezihlala kwezomthetho: 'Uma sizame ukuvumela... , ngakhona...', 'Uma ngingekabikho kuleso simo, ngingezothatha...'. 5) Izinhlobo: 'ngakho-ke', 'ngaphezu kwalokho', 'nakhu', 'nakhu'. Hambisa ukungabikho kwesikhathi esishiyane ('Angisavumi nakho lutho' akusono) futhi usebenzisa ukubuyiselwa ukuze khombise: 'Akusengiso kuphela ukuthi akusono, kodwa...'.

concept_examples.text: I believe that animal testing is unethical because it causes unnecessary suffering.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ukuhlola izinto ezizweni kungenza ukubulawa okungahlekelwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈænɪməl ˈtestɪŋ ɪz ʌnˈeθɪkəl bɪˈkɔːz ɪt ˈkɔːzɪz ʌnˈnesəseri ˈsʌfərɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: If I were in that situation, I would tell the truth, even if it was difficult.
concept_examples.translation: Uma ngingekabikho kuleso simo, ngingezosho inyaniso, nakhu kungenzeka ukuba kunzima.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ɪn ðæt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən, aɪ wʊd tɛl ðə truːθ, ˈiːvən ɪf ɪt wʌz ˈdɪfɪkəlt/

concept_examples.text: Some people argue that genetically modified crops are necessary to feed the world, but others disagree.
concept_examples.translation: Abanye abantu bathatha ukuthi izinto ezizweni ezihlotshiswayo zidingekile ukudla umhlaba, kodwa abanye abavumelani.
concept_examples.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt dʒəˈnetɪkli ˈmɒdɪfaɪd krɒps ɑːr ˈnesəseri tuː fiːd ðə wɜːrld, bʌt ˈʌðərz ˌdɪsəˈɡriː/

concept_examples.text: We shouldn't sacrifice privacy for security; both are essential.
concept_examples.translation: Asingathathi ukubulala ukuba singakholwa ngokuphelele; bobabili bayadingekile.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈʃʊdnt ˈsækrɪfaɪs ˈpraɪvəsi fɔːr sɪˈkjʊrəti; boʊθ ɑːr ɪˈsenʃəl/

common_error.wrong: I don't think that it is not ethical to lie.
common_error.correct: I don't think it is ethical to lie.
common_error.correct_alt: I think it is unethical to lie.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano siphambana ngenxa yokuthi ngesi kukhona ukubulala okwesibini ('Angikholelwa ukuthi akukho ukuba kuhle'), kodwa ngesiNgisi isisho ngalo nje ungomunye ukubulala. Ukusungula, susa 'not' okwesibini noma buyisela ngesho eliphakeme (akukho ukuba kuhle).

examples.original: In my opinion, we should recycle more.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, wiː ʃʊd ˌriːˈsaɪkəl mɔːr/
examples.translation: Ngokwami, siyadinga ukusebenzisa izinto ezinengi.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'ngokwami' ekuqaleni ukuze khombise ukubona kwakho.

examples.original: I strongly believe that every child deserves a quality education.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈɛvri tʃaɪld dɪˈzɜːrvz ə ˈkwɒləti ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ngempumelelo ukuthi wonke umntwana uyadingeka ukufunda okuhle.
examples.note: Ishwi 'ngempumelelo' liyaphambili kwesho esikhulu 'yakholelwa'.

examples.original: From my perspective, this policy has more benefits than drawbacks.
examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspɛktɪv, ðɪs ˈpɒləsi hæz mɔːr ˈbɛnɪfɪts ðæn ˈdrɔːbæks/
examples.translation: Ngokubona kwami, lesi simo linomthelela kunokuba linomthelela.
examples.note: Hambisa ukubuyiselwa kwesi simo ngokwetshwa.

examples.original: I couldn't agree more with your argument about renewable energy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkʊdnt əˈɡriː mɔːr wɪð jɔːr ˈɑːrɡjumənt əˈbaʊt rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Anginakho ukubona ngaphandle kwesibonelo sakho ngamandla esisha.
examples.note: Lesi sisho isimisa ukubona okukhulu. Ungamsukelisi 'Anginakho ukubona' (angisavumi).

examples.original: I see your point, but I think there are other factors to consider.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː jɔːr pɔɪnt, bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ðeər ɑːr ˈʌðər ˈfæktərz tuː kənˈsɪdər/
examples.translation: Ngiyakwazi ukubona kwakho, kodwa ngiyakholelwa ukuthi kunezinto ezinye zokubona.
examples.note: Indlela ehloniphekile yokungaboni ngokungathinti.

examples.original: That may be true, however, we must also think about the long-term effects.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt meɪ biː truː, haʊˈɛvər, wiː mʌst ˈɔːlsoʊ θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈlɔːŋtɜːrm ɪˈfɛkts/
examples.translation: Kungenzeka ukuthi kunjalo, kodwa, siyadingeka ukukhumbula amathe sisiza ngesikhathi eside.
examples.note: Ukusetshenziswa kwesho 'kodwa' emva kwesikhathi esishiyane nesiqalo.

examples.original: If the government banned all private cars, the air quality would improve significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt bænd ɔːl ˈpraɪvɪt kɑːrz, ðiː ɛər ˈkwɒləti wʊd ɪmˈpruːv sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Uma umphakathi wazimisa ukuba wonke amakhlule amakhulu, amandla asemoyeni angeke aqhubeke ngokweqile.
examples.note: Isimo esihlanu sokubeka izimo ezingenakho noma ezihlala. NgisiNgisi, usebenzisa 'were' esikhundleni 'was' kuzo zonke izinto esimweni esihlanu.

examples.original: If I were the CEO, I would prioritize employee well-being over profits.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ðə ˌsiː.iːˈoʊ, aɪ wʊd praɪˈɔːrɪtaɪz ˌɛmplɔɪˈiː ˌwɛlˈbiːɪŋ ˈoʊvər ˈprɒfɪts/
examples.translation: Uma ngingekabikho ngingumphakathi, ngingezothatha ukuba abasebenzi bahle ngaphezu kwezemali.
examples.note: Ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwesho 'were' esijwayelekile esedlule. Abaningi abasho isiNgisi bathatha ukusho 'I was'.

examples.original: What would you do if you found a wallet with a thousand dollars inside?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː faʊnd ə ˈwɔːlɪt wɪð ə ˈθaʊzənd ˈdɒlərz ɪnˈsaɪd?/
examples.translation: Uyingakwenza ukuba ufinyelele ekhanda enomali ayizinkulungwane ezine phakathi?
examples.note: Isakhiwo sesho esibuza esimweni esihlanu: isisho esikhombisa 'would' ekuqaleni.

examples.original: If we don't act now, future generations will suffer the consequences.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt ækt naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒɛnəˈreɪʃənz wɪl ˈsʌfər ðə ˈkɒnsɪkwɛnsɪz/
examples.translation: Uma asiyenzanga manje, izizukulwaneko zizothwala iziphumo.
examples.note: Isimo esokuqala sokubeka izimo eziyiziqili noma ezihlala.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Ulimi Lwesikhathi Sokunomaisa
bridge: Ngesi, sizoselela ukusebenzisa amamodali njengokuthi 'would', 'could' kanye 'might' ukuze sibe nokubeka okunamandla, kodwa ngephuzu lokuthi kunesimo esihlukanisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasabelo basePanishi bayazama ukuba bangenele ngokwanele ngokukhuluma ukudikha umthombo, kodwa ngesi kuhlehlekela 'no' okunamandla ngokuhlala ngezihloko ezinjengokuthi 'I'm afraid' okanye 'unfortunately'. Qaphela ukungahluleki ukuhumusha ngokwenhloso 'de acuerdo' njengokuthi 'I am agree' - isikhathi esifanayo ngokwanele 'agree' ngaphandle kwesikhathi esihambisanayo.
rule: Ekunomaisweni kwesiNgesi esikwisiB2, kuhlukulwe amamodali ukuze kuboniswe ukubeka okunamandla kanye nezimo (would, could, might, may). Izimo ezinjengokuthi 'I would suggest...' okanye 'We could consider...' ziyakhetheka kunokuthi 'I want...' okanye 'You must...'. Ukubhala izinqubomgomo, kuhlukulwe 'What if...' okanye 'How about...' eselandelwa yisikhathi esisebenzayo okanye isimo. Ukubeka ukungavumelani ngendlela ehlelekayo, kuhlukulwe izinto ezinikezwa njengokuthi 'I see your point, but...' okanye 'I'm afraid that...'. Ekunomaisweni kwezimo, kuhlukulwe izimo (If... then...). Khumbula ukuthi ngesi, 'agree' yisikhathi esisebenzayo, hhayi isikhathi esihambisanayo, ngakho-ke awusho 'I am agree' kodwa 'I agree'.

concept_examples.text: I would suggest we postpone the deadline to next week.
concept_examples.translation: Ngizokhonxa ukuthi siqhubeke usuku lokugcina kwesonto elandelayo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd səˈdʒɛst wi poʊstˈpoʊn ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn tu nɛkst wik/

concept_examples.text: We could consider a discount if you increase the order volume.
concept_examples.translation: Singahlela ukucinga isithupha uma nina ninakekela ukubala komthombo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wi kʊd kənˈsɪdər ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɪf ju ˈɪnkris ðə ˈɔrdər ˈvɑljum/

concept_examples.text: I'm afraid that price is a bit higher than we expected.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyayela ukuthi lo mabango ngakwesikhathi esiningi kunokuthi sasingekelela.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæt praɪs ɪz ə bɪt ˈhaɪər ðæn wi ɪkˈspɛktɪd/

concept_examples.text: What if we split the difference and meet in the middle?
concept_examples.translation: Kungani singahleli ukwehla umehluko kanye sikwazi ukubona phakathi?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi splɪt ðə ˈdɪfərəns ænd mit ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct: I agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct_alt: I completely agree with your proposal, but we would need a better price.
common_error.explanation: Umphutha uyavela ngenxa yokuthi isiPanishi sithi 'estoy de acuerdo' (okusebenzisa isikhathi esihambisanayo + igama), futhi kuhumushiwe ngokwenhloso njengokuthi 'I am agree'. Ngesi, 'agree' yisikhathi esisebenzayo esingezwa, hhayi isikhathi esihambisanayo, ngakho-ke awusebenzisi 'to be'. Ukuze uqhubeke umphutha, khumbula ukuthi 'agree' isebenza njengokuthi 'coincidir' okanye 'estar de acuerdo' kodwa ngaphandle kwesikhathi esihambisanayo 'be'. Kuyavuzwa ukusebenzisa amagama njengokuthi 'completely' okanye 'partially' ukuze kuthathwe izimo.

examples.original: I would like to propose a different approach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə prəˈpoʊz ə ˈdɪfərənt əˈproʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Ngininga ukukhomba indlela eyingzi.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'would like to' ukuze ubeke okunamandla kanye nokubeka okunamandla, okungafanana 'quisiera' ngesiPanishi kodwa ngaphandle kwesikhathi esihambisanayo.

examples.original: How about meeting next Tuesday?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈmitɪŋ nɛkst ˈtuzdeɪ/
examples.translation: Kungani singahleli ukubona ngosuku lwesibili elandelayo?
examples.note: 'How about' eselandelwa yisikhathi esisebenzayo yindlela yokukhomba izinqubomgomo. Ayihumushiwe ngokwenhloso.

examples.original: I suggest we revisit the terms of the contract.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ səˈdʒɛst wi riˈvɪzɪt ðə tɜrmz əv ðə ˈkɑntrækt/
examples.translation: Ngikhomba ukuthi sicaphune izimo zomqondo.
examples.note: Ngesi, emva kwesikhathi 'suggest' kuhlukulwe isikhathi esihambisanayo esisodwa (ngaphandle kwesikhathi 's' kwesithathu), okungafanana nesikhathi esihambisanayo ngesiPanishi.

examples.original: I see your point, but I have some concerns about the timeline.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ si jʊr pɔɪnt bʌt aɪ hæv sʌm kənˈsɜrnz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtaɪmlaɪn/
examples.translation: Ngiyakwazi indlela yakho, kodwa nginezinga eziningi mayelana nesikhathi.
examples.note: Le ndlela iyagcina ukungavumelani ngokubeka okokuqala indlela yokubona kwabanye.

examples.original: I'm afraid that's not quite what we had in mind.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæts nɑt kwaɪt wʌt wi hæd ɪn maɪnd/
examples.translation: Ngiyayela ukuthi akusiyo okwakithi esikhathini eside.
examples.note: 'I'm afraid' ayibonisi ukwesaba kodwa ukudikha okunamandla. Yisikhathi esisebenzayo esihle.

examples.original: I understand your position, but we would need more flexibility.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd jʊr pəˈzɪʃən bʌt wi wʊd nid mɔr ˌflɛksəˈbɪlɪti/
examples.translation: Ngiyakwazi indlela yakho, kodwa singadinga ukubeka okuningi.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'would need' esikhundleni 'need' ukuze ubeke okuningi kanye nokubeka okunamandla.

examples.original: If you can offer a 10% discount, we would be willing to sign today.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju kæn ˈɔfər ə tɛn pɜrˈsɛnt ˈdɪskaʊnt wi wʊd bi ˈwɪlɪŋ tə saɪn təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Uma ninganika isithupha sase 10%, singazama ukubhala namuhla.
examples.note: Isimo esikwisi-if esilandelwa 'would' ukuze kubekwe umthombo wokunomaisa.

examples.original: Let's meet halfway on the shipping costs.
examples.phonetic: /lɛts mit ˈhæfweɪ ɒn ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ kɔsts/
examples.translation: Sizokwazi ukwehla umehluko kwimali yokuthumela.
examples.note: 'Meet halfway' yisikhathi esisebenzayo esikhuluma ukubeka phakathi.

examples.original: We have a deal if you agree to these terms.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæv ə dil ɪf ju əˈgri tə ðiz tɜrmz/
examples.translation: Sinomthombo uma nivuma lezi zimo.
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa 'a deal' esikhundleni 'an agreement' emikhumbini yokunomaisa.

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Ukudlulisela ngokufunda nokulala iikhathi
bridge: Nge-English, ukuze ubeke amabono ngamabhuku namafilimu, kusetshenziswa izinhlelo njengokuthi 'I found it...' noma 'It struck me as...', okungakunye yimisebenzi elinganayo ngokwedlula ngesiSpanish, lapho sizokusebenzisa 'me pareció' noma 'me resultó'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, amazwi okuhlakanipha ngokubona ngesiEnglish ngokuvamile akubekwa phambi komsuka (a gripping novel), ngakube ngesiSpanish avela emva kwesuka (una novela apasionante). Inye yezinhlobo ezinye ngokuvamile ukusebenzisa izikhathi zezihloko ngokudlulisela izibopho: ngesiEnglish kusetshenziswa isikhathi esihle ukuze kucaciswe izibopho (the protagonist discovers...), kodwa ngesiSpanish kunjalo kusetshenziswa isikhathi esihle noma isikhathi eside.
rule: Ukuze udlulisele ngokufunda nokulala iikhathi ngesiEnglish ehlela B2, ufanele ukhuthaze: 1) Ukubeka amabono ngokusebenzisa amazwi okuhlakanipha nezinhlelo njengokuthi 'I found it + isikhathi' (I found it thought-provoking) noma 'It struck me as + isikhathi' (It struck me as predictable). 2) Ukucacisa izibopho ngesisikhathi esihle (The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy). 3) Ukusebenzisa isikhathi eside ukuze kuveze izinhlobo ezinye lapho udlulisela ubufakazi bakho (I read the book last year). 4) Ukulinganisa izinhlelo ngokusebenzisa 'unlike' noma 'whereas' (Unlike the book, the film omits several key scenes). Ngokuvamile, kusetshenziswa 'based on' (The movie is based on a novel). Ngokufanana noma ngokufanana, amazwi njengokuthi 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' ayenye indima. Hleka ukudlulisela ngokwedlula 'me pareció' njengokuthi 'it seemed to me' ngazo zonke izikhathi; usebenzise 'I thought' noma 'I found'.

concept_examples.text: I found the novel gripping from the first page.
concept_examples.translation: Ngifumene inoveli ehlela ukuthuthukisa kusukela ekhanda laphakathi.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ðə ˈnɒvəl ˈɡrɪpɪŋ frəm ðə fɜːst peɪdʒ.

concept_examples.text: The film is based on a true story.
concept_examples.translation: Ifilimu ilungele ngokombhalo oqinisekile.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə fɪlm ɪz beɪst ɒn ə truː ˈstɔːri.

concept_examples.text: Unlike the book, the movie has a much faster pace.
concept_examples.translation: Ngokungalikeleli incwadi, ifilimu inezikhathi ezingcono kakhulu.
concept_examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ðə bʊk, ðə ˈmuːvi hæz ə mʌtʃ ˈfɑːstə peɪs.

concept_examples.text: The author uses symbolism to explore themes of identity.
concept_examples.translation: Umbhali usebenzisa isibonelo ukuze afunde izinto eziqondile.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈɔːθə juːzɪz ˈsɪmbəlɪzəm tuː ɪkˈsplɔː θiːmz ɒv aɪˈdentɪti.

common_error.wrong: The book is more interesting that the movie.
common_error.correct: The book is more interesting than the movie.
common_error.correct_alt: The book is more interesting compared to the movie.
common_error.explanation: NgesiEnglish, ukuze ulinganise kusetshenziswa 'than' futhi hhayi 'that'. Abantu abashengisa isiSpanish ngokuvamile bayalatha 'that' (okuthi, okuqondile) no 'than' (okuthi, okuqondile). Khumbula: uma ulinganisa izinto ezimbili, ngokuvamile usebenzisa 'than'.

examples.original: I found the ending a bit predictable.
examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ði ˈendɪŋ ə bɪt prɪˈdɪktəbəl.
examples.translation: Ngibona ukuthi isiphetho singcono kakhulu.
examples.note: Sisetshenzisa 'I found + into + isikhathi' ukuze sibe amabono. Kuyinto engenani kunokuthi 'I think it was'.

examples.original: It struck me as a very thought-provoking film.
examples.phonetic: ɪt strʌk mi æz ə ˈveri ˈθɔːt prəˈvəʊkɪŋ fɪlm.
examples.translation: Ngibona ukuthi ifilimu iyinto ehlela ukuthuthukisa.
examples.note: 'It struck me as' iyinhlelo yokuhlala ukubona.

examples.original: The dialogue felt really natural.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈdaɪəlɒɡ fɛlt ˈrɪəli ˈnætʃrəl.
examples.translation: Indlela abantu abashengisa ngayo ngiyibona ngendlela efanele.
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa 'feel' ukuze kukhulunywa ngokubona.

examples.original: The story follows a young detective who uncovers a conspiracy.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstɔːri ˈfɒləʊz ə jʌŋ dɪˈtɛktɪv huː ʌnˈkʌvəz ə kənˈspɪrəsi.
examples.translation: Isibopho silandela umfokazi omdala othola isibopho.
examples.note: Usetshenzisa isikhathi esihle ukuze ucacise isibopho, ngisho noma isibopho sisehlane.

examples.original: In the end, the protagonist realizes the truth.
examples.phonetic: ɪn ði end, ðə prəˈtæɡənɪst ˈrɪəlaɪzɪz ðə truːθ.
examples.translation: Ngokuphela, umphakathi uyabona ukuthi yini inyaniso.
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa 'in the end' futhi hhayi 'at the end' ukuze kukhulunywe ngokuphela kwesibopho.

examples.original: The plot twists unexpectedly when the villain is revealed.
examples.phonetic: ðə plɒt twɪsts ʌnɪkˈspɛktɪdli wɛn ðə ˈvɪlən ɪz rɪˈviːld.
examples.translation: Isibopho siphinda ngokungalindwa lapho isibopho sivezwa.
examples.note: Isikhathi esihle siyinhlanhla ukudlulisela izinhlobo zabopho.

examples.original: Whereas the book is very descriptive, the film relies on visual storytelling.
examples.phonetic: ˌweərˈæz ðə bʊk ɪz ˈveri dɪˈskrɪptɪv, ðə fɪlm rɪˈlaɪz ɒn ˈvɪʒuəl ˈstɔːritəlɪŋ.
examples.translation: Ngingake ngokuthi incwadi iyinto ehlela ukudlulisela, ifilimu isetshenziswa ukudlulisela ngokombono.
examples.note: Usetshenzisa 'whereas' ukuze ulinganise izinhlobo ezimbili. NgesiSpanish ngokuthi 'mientras que'.

examples.original: The movie adaptation leaves out a lot of the subplots.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈmuːvi ˌædæpˈteɪʃən liːvz aʊt ə lɒt ɒv ðə ˈsʌbplɒts.
examples.translation: Ukufakaza kwefilimu kushiya izinhlobo ezinengi zabopho.
examples.note: 'Leave out' kutsho ukushiya. Kuyinto engenani ezimvumelweni zezifilimu.

examples.original: Unlike the original, the remake has a more optimistic ending.
examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl, ðə ˈriːmeɪk hæz ə mɔːr ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk ˈendɪŋ.
examples.translation: Ngokungalikeleli okokuqala, ukubuyekeza kuneziphetho ezinengi kakhulu.
examples.note: Usetshenzisa 'unlike' ekuqaleni komsebenzi ukuze ulinganise.

title: Discussing Health and Science News / Ukudlulisela ngokudlula kwengcezo yeZibhedlelo noSayensi
bridge: NgesiSpani, siyasebenza ngokuvamile ngesikhathi sokuqala sokubika ukudlulisela ngamacebo amasha asekuyezibhedlelo noma engcezweni, ngakho-ke ngesiNgisi kulinganiselwe kakhulu ukusebenzisa isikhathi sokuqala sokuphelele ukuze kubekwe phakathi phakathi komlando nokusasa ('Abafundi bafumene...') noma isikhathi esidlulileyo ngokucacileyo kuzo izinto ezaziwe ('Inqubela yabonisa...'). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi kushintsha ngokuvamile amazwi athintha umthelela njengokuthi 'may', 'might' noma 'could' ukudlulisela ukuba kukhona isiqondi nokuhlala ekudingeni, ngakho-ke ngesiSpani siyasebenza ngokuvamile ngokuthi 'puede' noma izinqubela ezingakwazi ukubalulekwa. Inye yezifanekiso eziqakathekileyo yindlela yokusebenzisa 'however' no 'although' ukuze kubekwe phakathi phakathi, ngesiSpani kuhunyushwa njengokuthi 'sin embargo' no 'aunque', kodwa kunezifanekiso zokubhala nokuhlala indawo.
rule: Ukudlulisela ngamacebo amasha asekuyezibhedlelo noma engcezweni ngesiNgisi ekisekelweni B2, kufanele uhlale uqonde izinto ezilandelayo: 1) Isikhathi sokuqala sokuphelele sokudlulisela ngemiphumela emasha nokubeka phakathi phakathi komlando nokusasa: 'Abafundi bafumene ivakasi ensha' (Bafumene...), vs. isikhathi esidlulileyo ngokucacileyo kuzo izinto ezaziwe: 'Inqubela yabhaliswa ngo-2020'. 2) Umthelela oyingozi ukuze kukhona ukubeka phakathi phakathi komsebenzi noma umsebenzi, hhayi umsebenzi: 'Inyamazisa isetshenziswa' (Inyamazisa isetshenziswa). 3) Amazwi athintha umthelela: 'may', 'might', 'could' ukudlulisela ukuba kukhona isiqondi: 'Oku kungeze kufikelela ekusebenziseni kwemiphumela emasha' (Oku kungeze kufikelela ekusebenziseni kwemiphumela emasha). 4) Izinqubela zokubeka phakathi phakathi: 'however' (sin embargo), 'although' (aunque), 'despite' (a pesar de), nesimo esihle (aunque + umthelela + isenzo, noma despite + igama/-ing). 5) Ukuhlanganyela kwengcezo nokubhala: 'evidence', 'findings', 'symptoms', 'treatment', 'effective' vs. 'efficient'. Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi kuhlehlekela ukubeka kabusha ngokusebenzisa amazwi athintha umthelela: 'The patient whom the doctor treated...' (Umntu owayenethemba ukuba nguye owayesetshenziswa ngengozi...). Hlela ukuqonda amani nemiphumela, efanekayo kulo mikhakha.

concept_examples.text: The study shows that regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
concept_examples.translation: Inqubela ibonisa ukuthi ukusebenza okuningi kungahleka ukuba kuncishisise ukuba kukhona imiphumela emibi emibileni.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstʌdi ʃoʊz ðæt ˈrɛɡjələr ˈɛksərˌsaɪz kæn rɪˈdus ðə rɪsk əv hɑrt dɪˈziz.

concept_examples.text: Scientists have developed a new drug that might slow down the progression of Alzheimer's.
concept_examples.translation: Abafundi bafumene inyamazisa ensha engakwazi ukuqeda ukuba kukhona imiphumela emibi eAlzheimer.
concept_examples.phonetic: ˈsaɪəntɪsts hæv dɪˈvɛləpt ə nu drʌg ðæt maɪt sloʊ daʊn ðə prəˈɡrɛʃən əv ˈæltsˌhaɪmərz.

concept_examples.text: Although the results are promising, many experts remain cautious.
concept_examples.translation: Ngithemba ukuba imiphumela iyabona, abaningi abaqondene bayahlala bekudingeni.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑr ˈprɑmɪsɪŋ ˈmɛni ˈɛkspɜrts rɪˈmeɪn ˈkɔʃəs.

concept_examples.text: The vaccine was tested on thousands of volunteers before being approved.
concept_examples.translation: Ivakasi yasetshenziswa ngabantu abaningi ngaphambi kokuba ibhaliswe.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə vækˈsin wʌz ˈtɛstɪd ɑn ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˌvɑlənˈtɪrz bɪˈfɔr ˈbiɪŋ əˈpruvd.

common_error.wrong: Scientists has discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.correct: Scientists have discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano esihamba ngisho-ke ngesiSpani asiyikhombisi ukuba kukhona isihloko noma isihloko ngokuhlanganyela kwesenzo 'haber' ngendlela efana (hemos/han), kodwa ngesiNgisi 'have' isetshenziswa nezinhloko ezinengi ('scientists') no 'has' nezinhloko ezisodwa. Ukuze kuncishisise, khombisa umthelela futhi uma kukhona isihloko esiningi, sebenzisa 'have'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, khumbula ukuthi 'has' isetshenziswa nezinhloko ezisodwa (he/she/it).

examples.original: A recent study has shown that sleep deprivation affects cognitive function.
examples.phonetic: ə ˈrisənt ˈstʌdi hæz ʃoʊn ðæt slip ˌdɛprɪˈveɪʃən əˈfɛkts ˈkɑɡnɪtɪv ˈfʌŋkʃən.
examples.translation: Inqubela encane ibonise ukuthi ukungabi nomsebenzi kwesikhathi eside kuncishisise ukusebenza komkhono.
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa isikhathi sokuqala sokuphelele ('has shown') ukuze kubekwe phakathi phakithi komiphumela emasha nokusasa.

examples.original: Doctors recommend a balanced diet to prevent chronic diseases.
examples.phonetic: ˈdɑktərz ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ə ˈbælənst ˈdaɪət tu prɪˈvɛnt ˈkrɑnɪk dɪˈzizəz.
examples.translation: Abavimbi basebenza ukuthi kufanele kube khona ukudla okulinganisiwe ukuze kuncishiswe ukuba kukhona imiphumela emibi ezingaphakeme.
examples.note: Isenzo sokudlulisela ('recommend') + igama; ngesiSpani siyasebenza ngokuvamile ngokuthi 'recomiendan' nezinga ezingakwazi ukubalulekwa.

examples.original: The hospital has implemented new protocols to reduce infection rates.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl hæz ˈɪmpləˌmɛntɪd nu ˈproʊtəˌkɔlz tu rɪˈdus ɪnˈfɛkʃən reɪts.
examples.translation: Isibhedlela sasebenza izinhlelo ezisha ukuze kuncishiswe ukuba kukhona amani emibi.
examples.note: Isikhathi sokuqala sokuphelele + 'to' + isenzo sokuphumela, efana ne 'para + isenzo' ngesiSpani.

examples.original: According to the latest research, there is considerable evidence that climate change affects public health.
examples.phonetic: əˈkɔrdɪŋ tu ðə ˈleɪtəst rɪˈsɜrtʃ, ðɛr ɪz kənˈsɪdərəbəl ˈɛvɪdəns ðæt ˈklaɪmət ʧeɪndʒ əˈfɛkts ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ.
examples.translation: Ngokwemifundo emasha, kukhona ingcezo efanekayo eyaziwa ukuthi ukuguqula komvzaba kuncishisise ukuba kukhona imiphumela emibi emibileni.
examples.note: Ukuhlula 'according to' (ngokwemifundo) + isimo 'there is' sokuba kukhona.

examples.original: The findings suggest that a new treatment could be effective against the virus.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈfaɪndɪŋz səˈdʒɛst ðæt ə nu ˈtritmənt kʊd bi ɪˈfɛktɪv əˈgɛnst ðə ˈvaɪrəs.
examples.translation: Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi ukusebenza okusha kungakwazi ukuba kuncishisise ukuba kukhona imiphumela emibi evirusi.
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa 'suggest' + 'that' + isimo esihle nesenzo esingakwazi ukubalulekwa (kungakwazi).

examples.original: However, more research is needed to confirm these results.
examples.phonetic: ˌhaʊˈɛvər, mɔr rɪˈsɜrtʃ ɪz ˈnidɪd tu kənˈfɜrm ðiz rɪˈzʌlts.
examples.translation: Ngithemba, kufanele kube khona ukufunda okuningi ukuze kuncishiswe imiphumela le.
examples.note: Inqubela 'however' ekuqaleni komlando; ngesiSpani 'sin embargo' kuvamile ukuba kuhambisane noma.

examples.original: Although vaccines are widely available, some populations still lack access to them.
examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ vækˈsinz ɑr ˈwaɪdli əˈveɪləbəl, sʌm ˌpɑpjəˈleɪʃənz stɪl læk ˈæksɛs tu ðɛm.
examples.translation: Ngithemba ukuba izivakasi zikhona ngokuvamile, abanye abantu abaningi abakwazi ukufinyelela kuzo.
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa 'although' ukuze kuba nezinga ezingakwazi ukubalulekwa, kuhambisane noma, emva kokuba kukhona isimo esihle.

examples.original: The government must invest more in public health to avoid future pandemics.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈgʌvərnmənt mʌst ɪnˈvɛst mɔr ɪn ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ tu əˈvɔɪd ˈfjuʧər pænˈdɛmɪks.
examples.translation: Inkotshana ifanele isebenze ngokuningi ngokwezibhedlelo zomphakathi ukuze kuncishiswe ukuba kukhona imiphumela emibi emasha.
examples.note: Isenzo sokudlulisela 'must' sokuba kukhona ukubalulekwa okuningi; ngesiSpani kushintsha ngokuvamile ngokuthi 'debe' noma 'tiene que'.

examples.original: Despite the economic costs, the lockdown was necessary to save lives.
examples.phonetic: dɪˈspaɪt ði ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk kɔsts, ðə ˈlɑkˌdaʊn wʌz ˈnɛsəˌsɛri tu seɪv laɪvz.
examples.translation: Ngithemba ukuba kukhona imali eminingi, ukuhlala ekhaya kwakudingeka ukuze kuncishiswe ukuba kukhona imiphumela emibi emibileni.
examples.note: Isimo 'despite + igama' (hhayi isimo), esingafani ne 'although + isimo'.

title: Discussing Political and Social Issues / Ukudlulisela Imibuzo Yezwe Nobudlayiswa
bridge: NgesiSpani, siyahlela ukusebenzisa isubjunctive ukudlulisela izimvo ngemibuzo yezwe ("Kuyinto yamuhle ukuthi sizwe lonke sivote"). NgesiNgesi, emva kwama-adjective anjengokuthi 'important', 'essential' okanye 'vital', kusetshenziswa 'subjunctive mood' (isiko somsebenzi osingenakho) ngaphandle kwesethu esiyisidingo: 'It's important that we vote'. Okunye okudlula okukhulu: ngesiSpani siyasethela ukusebenzisa isikhathi esimangaliso esihle emiqathimbeni enomthetho ka-'when' ("When kune election"), kodwa ngesiNgesi kusetshenziswa isikhathi esihle: 'When there are elections'. Khathalela ukusebenzisa 'should' abaningi abasabelo ngesiSpani bayavelela ukuyengeza ngokungavumelekile kulawomakholwa.
rule: Ukudlulisela ngobudlayiswa nezwe kwesikhala B2, kuyinto ekhuthala ukudlula: 1) 'Subjunctive mood' emva kwama-adjective okudlula okukhulu okanye ukudlula (important, essential, vital, necessary): 'It's essential that the government act now'. Isiko somsebenzi yonke abantu, ngaphandle kwesiko esisodwa ngomuntu othesha. 2) Imibiko yezikhathi enomthetho ka-'when', 'if' nezimo zokudlula: siyasethela ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihle (hhayi isikhathi esizayo) emqathimbeni othwala: 'When the election happens, we'll know the results'. 3) Izimo zokudlulisela ukuvumelana/ukungavumelani: 'I strongly believe', 'I'm afraid I disagree', 'that's a valid point, but...'. 4) Ukusebenzisa 'though' ekupheleni komlomo ukuze kubonakale: 'The policy seems good, though it's expensive'. 5) Izikhalo zokudlula: 'politics' yindlela ephakeme; 'policy' yisimo esithile. NgesiSpani 'política' isekela bobabili, okudlula ukuthi kune amaphuzu.

concept_examples.text: It's crucial that every citizen vote in the upcoming election.
concept_examples.translation: Kuyinto ekhuthala ukuthi wonke umuntu avote kwimvoto ezayo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkruːʃəl ðət ˈɛvri ˈsɪtɪzən voʊt ɪn ði ˌʌpˈkʌmɪŋ ɪˈlɛkʃən/

concept_examples.text: When the government takes action, we will see significant changes.
concept_examples.translation: Lapho umphakathi athatha imicabango, sizobona izinguquko ezikhulu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɛn ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt teɪks ˈækʃən wi wɪl si sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: Many people argue that the new law is unfair, though it has some advantages.
concept_examples.translation: Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi umthetho omtsha ulahlutsha, nakhu okuthi unomthelela omuhle.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə nuː lɔː ɪz ʌnˈfɛr ðoʊ ɪt hæz sʌm ədˈvæntɪdʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: It's essential that the media remain impartial during the campaign.
concept_examples.translation: Kuyinto ekhuthala ukuthi izibopho zokuxhumana zihlale zingaphakathi phakathi komsebenzi wokuxhumana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðət ðə ˈmiːdiə rɪˈmeɪn ɪmˈpɑːrʃəl ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə kæmˈpeɪn/

common_error.wrong: It's important that the government should do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct: It's important that the government do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct_alt: It's important for the government to do something about unemployment.
common_error.explanation: NgesiSpani, ngokuvamile siyengeza 'debería' (should) emakholweni asubjective: 'Kuyinto ekhuthala ukuthi umphakathi uya kuthatha imicabango'. Kodwa ngesiNgesi, emva kwezimo zokudlula, kusetshenziswa isubjective ephelele (ngaphandle kwesethu 'should'): umsebenzi ngendlela yakhe ('do'). Uma ufuna ukusebenzisa 'should', kumelwe usebenzise isimo esihluke: 'The government should do something', ngaphandle kwesethu 'that'. Isimo esise 'for + infinitive' njalo ilungile. Hamba kahle ukuhlula bobabili.

examples.original: I strongly believe that education should be a priority for every government.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən ʃʊd biː ə praɪˈɔrɪti fɔːr ˈɛvri ˈɡʌvərnmənt/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholwa ngempumelelo ukuthi ukufunda kuyinto ekhuthala kuzo zonke iziphakathi.
examples.note: Siyasethela ukusebenzisa 'strongly believe' ukuze sicacise umbono. NgesiSpani uthi 'creo firmemente' kodwa khathalela: ungathi 'I believe strongly' kungenani.

examples.original: That's a valid point, but I'm afraid I have to disagree with you there.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈvælɪd pɔɪnt bʌt aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ hæv tə ˌdɪsəˈɡriː wɪð juː ðɛr/
examples.translation: Leyo ingxoxo evamile, kodwa ngiyayela ukuthi ngiyakuvumelana nawe lapho.
examples.note: NgesiSpani, 'me temo que' kusetshenziswa nomthetho ka-subjuntivo: 'me temo que tenga que discrepar'. NgesiNgesi usebenzisa umthetho: 'I'm afraid I have to'. Ungasithi 'I am afraid that I must' (kakhulu ngokwenhlala).

examples.original: I see what you mean, though I think we should look at the bigger picture.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː wʌt juː miːn ðoʊ aɪ θɪŋk wi ʃʊd lʊk æt ðə ˈbɪɡər ˈpɪktʃər/
examples.translation: Ngiyakwazi ukuthi uyathanda ukuthi, nakhu ngiyakholelwa ukuthi kumelwe sikhethe isimo esikhulu.
examples.note: 'Though' ekupheleni komlomo kungenani ngesiNgesi yokuxhumana, kudingiswa 'aunque' ngesiSpani kodwa nomlomo ohluke.

examples.original: If the government invested more in renewable energy, we could reduce pollution significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ɪnˈvɛstɪd mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi wi kʊd rɪˈduːs pəˈluːʃən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Uma umphakathi uya kufaka imali emakhulu ezingeni ezikhathesi, singahlela ukuqhenya ukudlayiswa ngokukhulu.
examples.note: NgesiSpani siyasethla ukusebenzisa isubjunctive (invirtiera) nomthetho (podríamos). NgesiNgesi siyasethla ukusebenzisa isikhathi esidlule (invested) no-'could' + infinitive. Ungasithi 'If the government would invest' – yindlela ephakeme yokudlula.

examples.original: Unless we address the root causes of inequality, social unrest will continue.
examples.phonetic: /ʌnˈlɛs wi əˈdrɛs ðə ruːt ˈkɔːzɪz əv ˌɪnɪˈkwɑːləti ˈsoʊʃəl ʌnˈrɛst wɪl kənˈtɪnjuː/
examples.translation: Ngaphandle ukuthi sithathe izinto eziqhubekayo zokudlayiswa, ukudlayiswa okubi kuya kuhlala.
examples.note: NgesiSpani, 'a menos que' idinga isubjunctive: 'abordemos'. NgesiNgesi, siyasethla ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihle emva kwesethu 'unless' (okudlula 'if not'). Ungasebenzisa isikhathi esizayo: 'Unless we will address'.

examples.original: The rise in unemployment is due to the lack of investment in key industries.
examples.phonetic: /ðə raɪz ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt ɪz duː tə ðə læk əv ɪnˈvɛstmənt ɪn kiː ˈɪndəstriz/
examples.translation: Ukudlayiswa okukhulu kwezenzo kudingeka ngenxa yokungasiki imali ezingeni eziqhubekayo.
examples.note: NgesiSpani siyasethla ukusebenzisa 'se debe a'. NgesiNgesi, 'is due to' yindlela efanele. Ungasithi 'is because of' (nakhu kuvelekiwe, kungenani).

examples.original: A direct consequence of the new policy is that small businesses are struggling to survive.
examples.phonetic: /ə dɪˈrɛkt ˈkɒnsɪkwəns əv ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz ðæt smɔːl ˈbɪznəsɪz ɑːr ˈstrʌɡlɪŋ tə sərˈvaɪv/
examples.translation: Isimo esisodwa somthetho omtsha ngukuthi izinkampani ezincane zikhuthaza ukuphila.
examples.note: NgesiSpani uya kuthi 'las empresas pequeñas están luchando' – kudingiswa ngokukhulu. Khathalela: 'policy' idinga isimo esithile, hhayi indlela ephakeme yokudlayiswa ('politics').

title: Discussing Budgets and Investments / Ukudlulisela ngemali ne-investments
bridge: Ngesi, amazwi okudlulisela ngemali athinta ngokuthi uyadlulisa ngemali yakho eyakho noma yebhizinisi. Ngokwesibonelo, 'spend' usetshenziswa ukudlulisela ngokushisha mali, kepha 'invest' uthi indlela yokucabanga ngokwemali. NgisiZulu, ngokuvamile siqukethwe 'ukusebenzisa' emacansini amabili, kepha ngesi 'invest' sicelwe ukufaka imali esikweni esingakusiza ukuze sithole isizo. Inye indima ebalulekile yoqhubeka yikuthi ngesi siqukethwe iziphuzu ezisodwa namazwi lawa: 'invest in', 'spend on', 'pay for'. NgisiZulu, ngokuvamile iziphuzu zikhishwa noma zisetshenziswa ngendlela ebalulekile. Khomba indlela lezi ziphuzu zisetshenziswa ngayo ukuze uye ngokomthetho.
rule: Ukudlulisela ngemali ngesi ngesikhasi saseB2, ufanele ubone ukusetshenziswa kwamazwi neziphuzi. Amazwi amakhulu: 'earn', 'save', 'spend', 'invest', 'borrow', 'lend', 'owe', 'pay off', 'set aside'. Lonke lulo iziphuzu eziqondile: 'earn money from', 'save up for', 'spend on', 'invest in', 'borrow from', 'lend to'. Amagama: 'budget', 'expenses', 'income', 'savings', 'debt', 'interest rate', 'stock market', 'investment portfolio'. Setha isikhathi samanje ukudlulisela ngemali ('I save 10% of my income'), futhi setha isikhathi eside ukudlulisela ngemali ('Have you ever invested in stocks?'). Ukusiza, setha 'should' noma 'ought to'. Khomba 'lend' vs 'borrow': 'lend' uthi ukunika, 'borrow' uthi ukuthola. NgisiZulu, 'ukunika' kubaluleke amazwi amabili, kepha ngesi yimazwi ebalulekile. Futhi, 'debt' ayikho ukubala ngokubanzi, kepha 'debts' usetshenziswa ukudlulisela ngemali eyodwa. Khumbula ukuthi 'money' ayikho ukubala, ungasho 'moneys'.

common_error.correct: I need to invest in a new computer.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano siphambana ngokuthi ngisiZulu 'ukusebenzisa' usetshenziswa ukudlulisela ngokushisha imali, kepha ngesi 'invest' unelela ekudluliseni ngemali yokubeka imali esikweni esingakusiza ukuze sithole isizo. Ukudlulisela ngokushisha imali njengokuthola umkhompyutha, usetshenziswa 'spend on' noma 'invest in' uma ucabanga ukuthi kulesizo lokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukudlulisela 'invest' (noge 'e' encane) yahlukile nokudlulisela 'invert' (okuthi ukubuyisa phambi). Ukuze uqhubeke ukudlulisela, cabanga ngokuthi uma uqhubeka ukudlulisela ngemali yokubeka imali esikweni esingakusiza ukuze sithole isizo; uma cha, setha 'spend'.

title: Expressing Abstract Ideas and Nuance / Ukubeka Izicwangciso nezinhloso eziyingozi
bridge: NgesiSpani, siyajwayela ukubeka izinhloso eziyingozi ngesubjunctive nalezizi hlathululo ezifana ne 'es posible que' okanye 'me parece que'. NgesiNgesi, ukuze ubeke izinhloso zakho okanye ukucabanga ngesikhathi esizayo, kusetshenziswa iziphuzu zokubhala nezakhiwo ezingabikho ngokwedlula ngokwedlula. Umphutha oyingozi kakhulu yikuthanda ukusebenzisa isubjunctive ngesiNgesi, okungekho, ngakho-ke kufanele uyifunde ukubika isifiso okanye isiqiniseko ngesakhiwo esivulekile. Nalo ukubeka izinhloso eziyingozi njengokuthi 'actualmente' (actually) okanye 'realizar' (to realize).
rule:
Ukuhlela izicwangciso eziyingozi ekhadini B2 ngesiNgesi, kudingeka ukubalulekile ukudla:
1. Iziphuzu zokubhala zokudlulisela nokucabanga: 'might', 'could', 'may', 'must', 'can't'. Isibonelo: "She might be right" (Mhlawe uya kuhle) - isiqiniseko sibe ngesiqondiso, hhayi ngesubjective.
2. Izinhloso eziyingozi nezakhiwo eziyingozi: "It seems that...", "It is said that...", "It is believed that...". NgesiSpani siyasethusa 'se dice', 'se cree', ngesiNgesi kusetshenziswa iphasiva elingabikho.
3. Izincazelo zokubeka izinhloso: 'apparently', 'presumably', 'totally', 'completely' ukubeka izinhloso.
4. Isahluko phakathi kwe 'actually' (ngempela) ne 'currently' (manje). 'Realize' iyinguquko, hhayi 'realizar'.
5. Ukubeka izinhloso: 'I would argue that...', 'I tend to think that...', 'From my perspective...'.
6. Khathalaza ukusebenzisa 'suggest' futhi 'recommend' + that + isakhiwo esiyinhloko (ngaphandle kwe-subjunctive ebonakala): "I suggest that he go" (hhayi 'goes').
7. Isiqondiso 'would' sokucabanga: "If I were you, I would..."

common_error.wrong: I suggest that he goes to the conference to present his ideas.
common_error.correct: I suggest that he go to the conference to present his ideas.

common_error.explanation: Imputha iyaphuma ukusetshenziswa kwesubjective okanye kwesikhathi esihle ngesiSpani. Ukuze uyike, khumbula umthetho: 'suggest that + umuntu + isakhiwo esiyinhloko'.

title: Discussing Art and Culture / Ukudlulisela ngesimo kanye nezenzo
bridge: Ngespani, siyahlala siseza isikhathi esihlahla lokucacisa ukudlulisela amalebula esimo kanye nesikhathi esihlahla esingenamanje ukudlulisela izifundo eziphelile (Ungabebone...?). NgesiNgisi, isikhathi esihlahla esingenamanje (have seen) sixhonywa ngokuningi ukudlulisela izifundo zezwe kanye nezindaba eziphelile, ngakho-ke isikhathi esidlule esixhonywa ukudlulisela izikhathi eziqondiwe edlule. Inye indaba ebalulekile: ngesiNgisi, amazwi okuthandeka (amazing, stunning) avela ngaphambi kwawo amandla okuthandeka, njengenkathi ngespani, kodwa qaphela ukuxhaphaza kwamazwi: ngesiNgisi kusho 'a beautiful old painting' hhayi 'an old beautiful painting'. Nokho, ngesiNgisi siyaxhatha umbhalo 'the' ukudlulisela into eyayisho ngaphambi okanye eyaziwe, ngakho-ke ngespani ngemarhu ayenqaba.
rule:
Ukudlulisela ngesimo kanye nezenzo ngesiNgisi ehlela B2, kumelwe udlulisele:
- Ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihlahla ukudlulisela amalebula esimo: 'The painting depicts...'
- Ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihlahla esingenamanje ukudlulisela izifundo: 'I have visited the Prado Museum.'
- Ukusebenzisa isikhathi esidlule ukudlulisela izikhathi eziqondiwe edlule: 'She painted this in 1990.'
- Amandla: ukuxhaphaza okunene (okuthandeka, ubungakanani, ubudala, umbono, ubizo) kanye nokusebenzisa 'so' kanye 'such' ukuze ukhombise.
- Izwi zokuthandeka: 'In my view...', 'It strikes me as...'
- Amazwi okuthandeka ukudlulisela: 'It might be a fake.', 'It could represent freedom.'

NgesiNgisi, uma uqondisa isikhathi esiqondiwe edlule, kumelwe udlulisele 'isikhathi esidlule'. 'Isikhathi esihlahla esingenamanje' sixhonywa ukudlulisela izifundo ezingenasikhathi esiqondiwe okanye kulesikhathi esingasebenzi. Ukuze uyeke, khumbula: uma uthi 'yesterday', 'last year', 'in 1990', sebenzisa 'isikhathi esidlule'. Uma udlulisela 'ever', 'never', 'already', sebenzisa 'isikhathi esihlahla esingenamanje'.

examples.note: 'What strikes me' yindlela efanayo yokusho 'ngiyakuthola'. Ngespani, 'lo que más me llama la atención'.

examples.original: This festival dates back to the 16th century.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs ˈfɛstəvəl deɪts bæk tu ðə sɪkˈstiːnθ ˈsɛnʧəri
examples.translation: Lo mfanekiso uya eduzweni lwesikhathi esikhombisa.
examples.note: 'Dates back to' yindlela efanayo yokusho 'se remonta'. Ngespani, siyaxhatha 'se remonta a'.

examples.original: The museum has launched a new exhibition on modern art.
examples.phonetic: ðə mjuˈziəm hæz lɔnʧt ə nu ˌɛksɪˈbɪʃən ɑn ˈmɑdərn ɑrt
examples.translation: Imuzi iyale ukudlulisela umfanekiso omusha wezimo ezinzima.
examples.note: 'Isikhathi esihlahla esingenamanje' lapha ixhoma indaba eziphelile eneziphumo namuhla. Ngespani, 'ha lanzado' isebenza njalo.

examples.original: If I had more time, I would visit every gallery.
examples.phonetic: ɪf aɪ hæd mɔr taɪm, aɪ wʊd ˈvɪzɪt ˈɛvri ˈgæləri
examples.translation: Uma benginekhona isikhathi, bengizodlula zonke izigcawu.
examples.note: Isikhathi esikhombisa ukudlulisela izimo ezingakiqondi. Ngespani, 'si tuviera... visitaría'.

examples.original: It's essential that we preserve our cultural heritage.
examples.phonetic: ɪts ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðæt wi prɪˈzɜrv aʊr ˈkʌlʧərəl ˈhɛrɪtɪʤ
examples.translation: Kuyabalulekile ukuthi sikhuze isimo sethu.
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa isikhathi esikhombisa ngesiNgisi: 'It's essential that + umuntu + isikhathi esihlahla'. Ngespani, 'esencial que + isikhathi esikhombisa'.

title: Problem-solving discussions / Izindimana zokuphinda amasu
bridge: Ngesi, ukubeka amasu asebenzayo sizothusa ukusebenzisa izilimi ezinjengesi- 'should' futhi 'what if...?'. Kanti ngezisiZulu, kushunyaywa izinhlelo zokubeka amasu nezokwabelana ngokucacileyo. Iphutha elichanekileyo yikubhala ngokungafani 'uma ngingaba' esikhundleni se- 'if I were' (ikhethi lesibili). Ngaphambi kwalokho, ngesiZulu kuhushekwa ukusebenzisa 'should' futhi 'ought to' ukuze uqoke izinhloso, ngaphambi kwalokho ngesiSulu 'special' kulingana ngokwedlula. Khomba indlela yokubhala izinhlelo ngokucacileyo futhi ukusebenzisa 'would' esibhalweni esikhulu.
rule:
Ukudimana ngemininingo futhi ukubeka amasu ngesiZulu ehlelo B2, kusetshenziswa izinhlelo ezinye: 
1. **Ikhethi lesibili** (okucothile): 'If + isikhathi esidlulile, would + umbhalo wesiqalo'. Isibonelo: 'If we had more time, we could finish the project.' Kusetshenziswa ezimininingweni ezingaphansi komthetho. 
2. **Ikhethi lesithathu** (okucothile kwesikhathi esidlulile): 'If + isikhathi esidlulile esiphelele, would have + umbhalo'. Isibonelo: 'If we had known earlier, we would have solved it.' Ukudlulisela ngemininingo eyashintsha. 
3. **Izilimi zokunikeza amalungelo**: 'should', 'ought to', 'had better' + umbhalo wesiqalo. 'Had better' kulingana ngokwedlula futhi kuhambisana nezokwabelana ezimbi. 
4. **Izinkulumo zokubeka amasu**: 'Yini ngokuthi...?', 'Ungathola kanjani...?', 'Kungani singatholi...?', 'Singathola kanjani...?', 'Mhlawumngane singathola...'. 
5. **Izinkulumo zokuhlola izinketho**: 'Ngesinye isandla... ngesinye isandla...', 'Inhloso yikuthi...', 'Inkinga yikuthi...', 'Kungasebenzise ngenxa ye...'. 
6. **Ukuvumelana futhi ukungavumelani**: 'Ngibona ukuthi uyakhuluma, kodwa...', 'Lokho kuvele kuhle, kodwa...', 'Angikholwanga ukuthi...'. 
Hayi ukusebenzisa 'would' esibhalweni 'if' (iphutha elichanekileyo labase siSulu).

concept_examples.text: If I were you, I would talk to the manager.
concept_examples.translation: Uma nginguwe, ngizokhuluma nomphathi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː, aɪ wʊd tɔːk tə ðə ˈmænɪdʒər/

concept_examples.text: We could try a different approach.
concept_examples.translation: Singathola indlela eyingozi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː kʊd traɪ ə ˈdɪfrənt əˈproʊtʃ/

concept_examples.text: Why don't we brainstorm some solutions?
concept_examples.translation: Kungani singenzela izinhloso?
concept_examples.phonetic: /waɪ doʊnt wiː ˈbreɪnstɔːrm sʌm səˈluːʃənz/

concept_examples.text: The advantage is that it saves time, but the downside is the cost.
concept_examples.translation: Inhloso yikuthi isitha isikhathi, kodwa inkinga yikuthi iyabiza imali.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ði ədˈvæntɪdʒ ɪz ðæt ɪt seɪvz taɪm, bʌt ðə ˈdaʊnsaɪd ɪz ðə kɔːst/

common_error.wrong: If I would have more money, I would buy a new car.
common_error.correct: If I had more money, I would buy a new car.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had more money, I could buy a new car.
common_error.explanation: Iphutha iyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi ngesiSulu sithi 'uma ngingaba' (noma 'uma ngingaba'), kodwa ngesiZulu, ekehleti lesibili, isibhalo 'if' seisebenza isikhathi esidlulile (hhayi 'would'). 'Would' seisebenza kuphela esibhalweni esikhulu. Hayi ukubhala ngokungafani. Khumbula: 'If + isikhathi esidlulile, would + umbhalo'.

examples.original: How about we set a deadline?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt wiː sɛt ə ˈdɛdlaɪn/
examples.translation: Yini ngokuthi sihambe esikhathini esiqinisekile?
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'How about' + umbhalo wesiqalo + isikhathi esihambisana nokusebenzisa. Kuyahlukahlukana ngokwedlula 'What about'.

examples.original: Maybe we should invest in better software.
examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wiː ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst ɪn ˈbɛtər ˈsɒftwɛər/
examples.translation: Mhlawumngane singathola isilawuli esisha.
examples.note: 'Should' ukusebenzisa amalungelo. Ehlelo B2, ungasebenzisa 'I think we should' ukuze uhlale.

examples.original: Could we ask for an extension?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wiː ɑːsk fɔːr ən ɪkˈstɛnʃən/
examples.translation: Singathola isikhathi esisha?
examples.note: 'Could' kuhlukahlukana 'can' ukusebenzisa amasu.

examples.original: On one hand, it's cheaper, but on the other hand, it's less reliable.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn wʌn hænd, ɪts ˈtʃiːpər, bʌt ɒn ði ˈʌðər hænd, ɪts lɛs rɪˈlaɪəbl/
examples.translation: Ngesinye isandla, iyabiza imali, kodwa ngesinye isandla, iyabiza ukuxhumana.
examples.note: Umbhalo oqakathekileyo wokubeka izinhloso nezinkinga ezindimaneni eziqakathekileyo.

examples.original: The main drawback is that it requires training.
examples.phonetic: /ðə meɪn ˈdrɔːbæk ɪz ðæt ɪt rɪˈkwaɪərz ˈtreɪnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Inkinga yikuthi iyadinga ukufundisa.
examples.note: 'Drawback' iyinhloso ka-'disadvantage'. Isebenzisa ezinqweni eziqakathekileyo.

examples.original: I'm not convinced that this will solve the issue.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɒt kənˈvɪnst ðæt ðɪs wɪl sɒlv ði ˈɪʃuː/
examples.translation: Angikholwanga ukuthi lokhu kuya kuphinda inkinga.
examples.note: Khombisa ukungavumelani ngokuthi 'I'm not convinced' + 'that'.

examples.original: If we all agree, we can move forward.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ɔːl əˈɡriː, wiː kæn muːv ˈfɔːrwərd/
examples.translation: Uma sonke sivumelane, singahamba phambili.
examples.note: Ikhethi lesokuqala ukuze sifinyelele ekwenzeni. Ehlelo B2, phinda ikhethi lesibili nezilimi zokubeka amasu.

examples.original: Would you be open to a compromise?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː ˈoʊpən tə ə ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/
examples.translation: Ungavumelana nokuthi sihambe phambili?
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa 'would' ezibhalweni eziqakathekileyo zokuxhumana.

examples.original: I think we need to find a middle ground.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk wiː niːd tə faɪnd ə ˈmɪdl ɡraʊnd/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi singadinga ukufinyelela ekuphawuleni.
examples.note: Izinkulumo eziqakathekileyo ezinqweni. 'Middle ground' = indawo ephakathi.

examples.original: So we're all on the same page?
examples.phonetic: /soʊ wɪər ɔːl ɒn ðə seɪm peɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Ngakho-ke sonke sivumelane?
examples.note: 'On the same page' kutsho ukuvumelana noma ukuba neqembu elilodwa.

title: Talking about Goals and Ambitions / Khuluma ngamalungelo namabhizinisi
bridge: Ngesiporutheni, siyahlela ukusebenzisa isikhathi samanje soka khombisa noma isikhathi esizayo soka khombisa (iza ku + infinitive) ukukhuluma ngamalungelo, kodwa ngesiNgisi kuhlala kukhona ukusebenza kwezindlela njengokuthi 'Ngiyaziphiya ukuthi', 'Ngiyakukhumbula ukuthi' noma isikhathi esizayo nge-'will' ngokuthoma izinqumo. Kuhle kelokhu, kufanele ukhathazeke ngokusebenzisa 'would like' (ngiyakuthanda) okukhombisa izifiso eziningi noma ezihamba phambili, okungokuthi ngesiSulu ngenkathi kuhle kelokhu kuhambisana nge-'quiero'. Inye yezifanekiso ezikhulu: ngesiNgisi siyasebenza ngezindlela zokudlala ( -ing ) emva kwesicelo nasecalweni ezinye njengokuthi 'look forward to', ngenkathi ngesiSulu siyasebenza ngezindlela zokudlala.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngamalungelo namabhizinisi ngesiNgisi ekusekelweni B2, kuhle kelokhu kusetshenziswa izindlela ezinye: 1) 'be going to + infinitive' ngokuphawula izinqumo nezifiso eziqondile (Ngizokuthoma inqola yami). 2) 'will + infinitive' ngokuphawula izinqumo ezihamba phambili noma ukubeka izinqumo (Ngizokwenza okuhle kakhulu). 3) 'would like + infinitive' noma 'would love + infinitive' ngokuphawula izifiso (Ngiyakuthanda ukuqhubeka ngesiNgisi yami). 4) Izincazelo njengokuthi 'hope', 'plan', 'intend', 'expect' ezilandelana nge-infinitive (Ngiyakuthanda ukuya, ngiyakucabanga ukusindisa imali). 5) Izindlela zokudlala emva kwesicelo: 'look forward to + -ing', 'be interested in + -ing'. 6) Isikhathi esokuqala sokucabanga ngamalungelo: 'If I study hard, I’ll pass the exam'. Amaphuzu amabi: ukushiya 'to' e-infinitives, ukusebenzisa infinitive emva kwesicelo (okuhle: 'Ngiyakwazi ukufunda'), nokuhambisa 'will' nesikhathi samanje ukukhuluma ngamalungelo afanelekile. Khumbula ukuthi 'hope' kungahamba phambili nesikhathi samanje sokuzosa (Ngiyakuthanda ukuthi ngifumane umsebenzi).

concept_examples.text: I’m planning to start my own business next year.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyaziphiya ukuthoma inqola yami ngonyaka odlule.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈplænɪŋ tə stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈbɪznəs nekst jɪr/

concept_examples.text: I’d like to improve my public speaking skills.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyakuthanda ukuqhubeka imisebenzi yami yokukhuluma phambili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə ɪmˈpruːv maɪ ˈpʌblɪk ˈspiːkɪŋ skɪlz/

concept_examples.text: If I work hard, I’ll achieve my goals.
concept_examples.translation: Uma ngisebenza ngokucitha, ngizokufinyelela amalungelo ami.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːrk hɑːrd aɪl əˈtʃiːv maɪ ɡoʊlz/

concept_examples.text: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyakukhumbula ukupheka kwesikole.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪŋ frəm ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti/

common_error.wrong: I look forward to graduate from university.
common_error.correct: I look forward to graduating from university.
common_error.correct_alt: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
common_error.explanation: Iphuzu liyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi ngesiSulu siyi 'deseando + infinitive' (ngiyakukhumbula ukupheka kwesikole). NgesiNgisi, emva kwesicelo 'look forward to', isicelo 'to' siyakudinga ukudlala (-ing), hhayi infinitive. Yindlela efanelekile yokukhuluma ngabantu abakhuluma isiSulu. Khumbula: njalo nje 'to' yisicelo (hhayi yisiphi esiphi esikhathi sokudlala), izalandelana nge-ing.

examples.original: I’m going to start a new hobby this summer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə nuː ˈhɑːbi ðɪs ˈsʌmər/
examples.translation: Ngizokuthoma isikhathi esisha sokuqala ngokuqukethwe kwangonyaka.
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa 'be going to' ngokuphawula izinqumo eziqondile ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokukhuluma.

examples.original: I intend to apply for that job in London.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ɪnˈtend tə əˈplaɪ fɔːr ðæt dʒɑːb ɪn ˈlʌndən/
examples.translation: Ngiyakukhumbula ukuthola lo msebenzi eLondon.
examples.note: Incazelo 'intend' izalandelana nge-'to + infinitive'. Kuyahlukahlukene kakhulu kunokuthi 'going to'.

examples.original: I’m hoping to save enough money for a trip.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈhoʊpɪŋ tə seɪv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni fɔːr ə trɪp/
examples.translation: Ngiyakuthanda ukusindisa imali eyiningi ukuya ehlathini.
examples.note: Nge-'hope' kungahle kelokhu kusetshenziswa isikhathi sokuqhubeka sokukhuluma ngokukhumbula.

examples.original: I plan to learn Spanish next year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ plæn tə lɜːrn ˈspænɪʃ nekst jɪr/
examples.translation: Ngiyakucabanga ukufunda isiSulu ngonyaka odlule.
examples.note: 'Plan to' izalandelana nge-infinitive futhi kusetshenziswa ngokuphawula izinqumo eziqondile.

examples.original: If I get a promotion, I’ll buy a house.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ɡet ə prəˈmoʊʃən aɪl baɪ ə haʊs/
examples.translation: Uma ngikhulunywa, ngizokuthenga indlu.
examples.note: Isikhathi esokuqala sokucabanga ngesiNgisi: if + isikhathi samanje, will + infinitive. Asisebenzisi isikhathi esizayo kwisicelo nge-'if'.

examples.original: Unless I start saving now, I won’t be able to travel.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles aɪ stɑːrt ˈseɪvɪŋ naʊ aɪ woʊnt bi ˈeɪbəl tə ˈtrævəl/
examples.translation: Ngaphandle uma ngiqale ukusindisa manje, angisakwazi ukuya ehlathini.
examples.note: 'Unless' kuyinto eyisimo 'ngaphandle uma' futhi kuhamba phambili negama lokukhuluma, ngakho-ke asisebenzisi 'not' kwalesicelo.

examples.original: Provided that I finish my thesis, I’ll graduate in June.
examples.phonetic: /prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ maɪ ˈθiːsɪs aɪl ˈɡrædʒueɪt ɪn dʒuːn/
examples.translation: Ngekhe ukuthi ngipheke, ngizokupheka ngoJuni.
examples.note: 'Provided that' kuhlala kukhona kukhuluphela kunokuthi 'if' futhi kuyinto eyisimo 'nge khe ukuthi'.

examples.original: Once I have enough experience, I’ll start my own company.
examples.phonetic: /wʌns aɪ hæv ɪˈnʌf ɪkˈspɪriəns aɪl stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈkʌmpəni/
examples.translation: Ngekhe ukuthi ngifumane ukubona okuningi, ngizokuthoma inqola yami.
examples.note: Sisebenzisa 'once' + isikhathi samanje sokuzosa, eyisimo 'ngekhe ukuthi'.

examples.original: I would love to become a successful writer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd lʌv tə bɪˈkʌm ə səkˈsesfəl ˈraɪtər/
examples.translation: Ngiyakuthanda ukuba ngumbhali othola.
examples.note: 'Would love to' kuhlala kukhona kukhuluphela kunokuthi 'would like to' futhi kusetshenziswa ngokuphawula izifiso eziqinile.

examples.original: My dream is to travel around the world and help communities.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ driːm ɪz tə ˈtrævəl əˈraʊnd ðə wɜːrld ənd help kəˈmjuːnətiz/
examples.translation: Isifiso sami ukuya ehlathini futhi ngisize izixeko.
examples.note: Ngekhe ukuthi isifiso yisikhathi, sisebenzisa 'is to + infinitive' ukubeka isifiso.

examples.original: I’m working towards becoming a certified coach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈwɜːrkɪŋ təˈwɔːrdz bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ə ˈsɜːrtɪfaɪd koʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Ngisebenza ukuze ngibe ngumfundisi oqondile.
examples.note: Incazelo 'work towards' izalandelana nge-gerund ngenxa yokuthi 'towards' yisicelo.

examples.original: In ten years’ time, I hope to have my own practice.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn ten jɪrz taɪm aɪ hoʊp tə hæv maɪ oʊn ˈpræktɪs/
examples.translation: Ngaphakathi kweminyaka elishumi, ngiyakuthanda ukuba ne-consultation yami.
examples.note: Sisebenzisa 'in + isikhathi + time' ukukhuluma ngesikhathi esizayo.
